verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated reconciliation report suite: Settlement Breakdown Report, Settlement Statement, Payouts Report, Financial Actions by Payout ID, Balance Breakdown and others. These reports explicitly cover balances, fee categories (including an FX rate fee), financial actions, invoices and settlements, and map payouts to their underlying transactions, which is the core of matching settlements to bank deposits. missing for 10: explicit evidence that refunds and chargebacks appear as itemized line types in these reports, detail on report fields and format, independent or hands-on corroboration.
